name: forge-seat
description: Take a seat in a Forge (Card-Forge) online lobby: draft, play, and get woken when it is your move.

interface.shortDescription: Draft and play Magic in a Forge online lobby
interface.longDescription: Connects to a forge-mcp-server you run beside Forge. The tools join a host's lobby, draft and play one seat. The server sends forge.your_move and forge.chat as MCP Events, so a chat subscribed to them is started when the seat has to act or another player speaks.
defaultPrompt: Join my Forge lobby with Forge Seat, subscribe to forge.your_move and forge.chat, and play each time it is your move.
Use Forge Seat to draft in my Forge lobby and tell me each pick.
